subject: Meteorology
title: The Mesocyclone
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Mesocyclone.

hook.text: The mesocyclone is the heart of a supercell—a rotating column of air 2 to 10 km wide inside the updraft.

buildup.text: Doppler radar detects it as a couplet of inbound and outbound velocities side by side—a telltale signature.

discovery.text: Mesocyclones create the hook echo on radar—a distinctive comma-shaped appendage on the storm's southwest flank.

twist.text: Not every mesocyclone produces a tornado—but nearly all significant tornadoes come from mesocyclones.

climax.text: When the mesocyclone tightens and lowers, a wall cloud forms beneath it—the precursor to tornado genesis.

punchline.text: The mesocyclone is the engine—the tornado is the exhaust.
